· THE PROBLEM ·

Reach is plentiful. Real action is scarce.

Meta and Google sell you impressions. Influencer agencies sell you reach. The hard part — the part that actually moves a brand — is getting young Indians to do something. Promote your product authentically. Try it. Refer a friend. Share an opinion that helps you build a better thing.

That’s what Funngro does. We don’t sell impressions. We sell verified action from a real, opted-in audience.

· TWELVE WAYS BRANDS WORK WITH FUNNGRO USERS ·

Pick what you need. We’ll match the right cohort.
01
PROMOTION
Brand promotion

Awareness, brand-recall, social posts. Verified at the action level. Best for new launches, refreshes, and category education.

02
SAMPLING
Sampling campaigns

Real product trials with structured feedback. Right cohort, right city, right age. Best for FMCG, beauty, food & bev launches.

03
REFERRALS
Referral programs

Peer growth with Clan multipliers. Unique to Funngro. Best for fintech, edtech, gaming where peer trust converts.

04
INFLUENCER
Influencer marketing

Micro and nano creators across categories. Brief-led, approved before publish. Best for category-specific authority.

05
CONTENT
Content creation (UGC)

User-generated reels, posts, blogs, photos. You get the asset rights. Best for ads, social libraries, e-commerce listings.

06
INSIGHTS
Brand surveys & insights

Structured research, NPS, brand-tracker studies. Demographic-targeted. Best for ongoing brand-health monitoring.

07
APP TESTING
App testing & QA

Real users, real devices, real environments. Bug reports + usability feedback. Best for pre-launch and version validation.

08
IDEATION
Product ideation

Concept-test new ideas with the actual target cohort. Quick rounds, real reactions. Best for product teams pre-build.

09
SALES
Sales support & conversion

Affiliate-style brand promotion with conversion tracking. Pay per sale. Best for e-commerce and subscription brands.

10
LOYALTY
Loyalty & re-engagement

Always-on engagement loops with existing customers. Best for retention-focused brands and subscription products.

11
CAMPUS
Campus ambassadors

On-ground presence in colleges. Posters, events, peer outreach. Best for brands targeting student-specific moments.

12
PARTNERSHIP
Brand partnerships

Always-on creator deals with top Funngro earners. Monthly retainer model. Best for brands building consistent youth presence.

From fintech to FMCG.
